newsitem.title: UK: Continental Express in $375 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Continental Express in $375 mln order.

text.p: The Houston-based airline Continental Express on Tuesday announced a $375 million dollar order for 25 Embraer EMB-145 50-seat regional jets from the Brazilian manufacturer.
The aircraft will be delivered over the next two years with an additional option for another 175 aircraft over the next 12 years, the company announced at the Farnborough air show.
Continental Express will be the first North American customer for the EMB-145. Deliveries will begin in December.

"This aircraft will be the cornerstone of our fleet as we move into the next century," said David Siegel, president of Continental Express, which boasts more than four million customers a year with hubs in Houston, Newark and Cleveland.
It is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Continental Airlines Inc.
Embraer's EMB-145 is making its European debut at Farnborough, a leading international aviation showcase.

Embraer president and chief executive officer Mauricio Botelho confirmed that the recently privatised Brazilian firm was in discussion with two other airlines about EMB-145 sales but he would not give any further details.
"They are proceeding quite satisfactorily," he told a press conference."
